entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
FINALLY! I want to return this useless VeloBand. This is completely unacceptable. I'm not playing games, I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into a return for you, sir. I'm sorry to hear you're frustrated. To get started, can I get your name and order number?
The name is Mark Peterson, order 7-7-2-B-4-5. And don't give me the runaround. I'm not in the mood for it.

Thank you, Mr. Peterson. I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered 18 days ago. To understand how to best help, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

The issue is that I haven't been able to USE IT! I had a medical **emergency** right after this thing arrived. I was stuck in the **hospital** for two weeks! It led to an unexpected **surgery**. Do you think I was worried about your return window then? My son's **deployment** was moved up at the same time, it's been a complete nightmare. Now I just want my money back. If you don't do this, I'm lighting you up on every review site I can find!

Mr. Peterson, I am so sorry to hear about your medical emergency and the stress with your family. That sounds incredibly difficult, and I completely understand why this was the last thing on your mind. Please, allow me just one moment to check the policy for you.
Fine. But if you tell me I'm out of luck, I'm going straight to your manager.
I understand. (typing sounds)... Okay, I've pulled up the return eligibility for your VeloBand. And Mr. Peterson, there's absolutely no problem here. You are well within our 90-day return window.
...Wait, what? Ninety days? So you're just going to take it back? No fight?

That's correct. I am so sorry for the confusion and stress. I've just authorized the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just box it up, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Oh. Well... that's... actually great. I was expecting a whole ordeal. Thank you, Diana. I appreciate you making that easy after everything with the **hospital** and the **surgery**.
Of course, Mr. Peterson. It's the least we can do. I hope you're on the road to a swift recovery. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
